Great composter bin. Very large capacity with an easy access top door in with removable door at the bottom to retrieve compost.

My old composter is cracking in seams after some 30 years of use. I have no expectation that this will last so long, just looking at the thin walls. It has no bottom, no secondary door opening. But it will have to serve for the immediate future.
